about: A dream tag match where SNK's sexy and cute heroines fight is open on PlayStation®4!

Activate various Special Moves with a single button, make use of special items to affect the tide of battle, and unique finish system etc. a new attractive fighting game is here! Also, there are three costumes and four different voice for each character and over 140 accessories to customize them with.
In QUICK MATCH, player can earn in-game currency, and ROOM MATCH, up to eight players can join in. You can also play using your customized character! Get excited with your friends!
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: A dream tag match where SNK's sexy and cute heroines fight is open on PlayStation®4!
